svg.title: Resolve priority before pricing a claim
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-lien-priority-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Resolve priority before pricing a claim; subtitle: A triage tree, not an automatic payout formula; chapter number: 7; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numbers identify nodes; branch directions are in the details. Applicable law and court orders control entitlement and ranking.; caption: Do not subtract every recorded lien mechanically: verify the sale type, lien status, priority, filed claims and the distribution procedure.; stages: label: Funds still held?; value: Node 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Yes: continue to node 2. No: locate the transfer or distribution record before further acquisition spending.; label: Claimant authority proven?; value: Node 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Yes: continue to node 3. No: obtain identity, title or estate authority documents; do not assume a relative can sign.; label: Competing claims resolved?; value: Node 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Yes: continue to node 4. No: send the docket, title chain and lien instruments for professional priority analysis.; label: Economic remainder?; value: Node 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Positive documented remainder: prepare the permitted claim. Zero or uncertain remainder: close or hold with a recorded reason.
